decisions.rationale: The profile reports row_count 9057 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so bronze contains no exact duplicate rows and no dedupe pass is applied.
id has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 9057 equal to row_count 9057, so it uniquely identifies every row; iata_code is also unique in this extract but id is the source system's primary key.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata in the profile; _airbyte_meta holds only '{}' and _airbyte_extracted_at spans a one-second single batch, so all three are dropped.

local_code (null_rate 0.636635), keywords (0.679585), and home_link (0.749034) are sparsely populated but retained nullable; no imputation and no row drops are performed.

purpose: Cleaned reference table of 9,057 airports from the OurAirports source, one row per airport id, providing identifiers (ident, ICAO, IATA, GPS, local codes), classification, geographic coordinates, elevation, and location hierarchy (continent, ISO country, ISO region, municipality) for downstream joins and geo analysis.
usage: Join on id (the declared grain) or on iata_code, which is also unique and non-null in this extract; icao_code, gps_code, and local_code are nullable and should not be used as join keys without null filtering. has_scheduled_service is a BOOLEAN derived from the source yes/no field. elevation_ft, municipality, and the link and keyword columns are nullable, so consumers must handle nulls explicitly.
limitations: No duplicate handling was needed (duplicate_row_rate 0.0). Several columns are sparsely populated and retained as-is: local_code is 63.7% null, keywords is 68.0% null, and home_link is 74.9% null; icao_code is 13.7% null and wikipedia_link 13.1% null. keywords is unstructured free text mixing alternate codes and names and was not parsed. Coordinates were narrowed from DECIMAL(38,9) to six decimal places based on observed sample precision; any sub-microdegree precision beyond the samples would be rounded.
